docs.title: The Sincerity Protocol
docs.text: Welcome to the official documentation for HUMANEXA, an elite, enterprise-grade platform designed to connect donors, helpers, and individuals in need with 100% transparency.

docs.title: 🌟 Vision & Mission
docs.text: To eliminate charity fraud and build a global 'Trust Economy.' HUMANEXA ensures every contribution reaches its intended destination through multi-staged AI verification, geolocation-based proof, and immutable reporting.

docs.title: Target Audience
docs.text:
• Ultra High Net Worth Individuals (UHNWI)
  • Institutional Donors
  • Verified Social Workers
  • Grassroots Helpers

docs.title: Core Pillars
docs.text:
1. Uncompromising Transparency: Powered by blockchain-inspired Sincerity Logs.
  2. AI-Driven Verification: Automated fraud detection and deepfake prevention.
  3. Privacy First: Built-in GDPR/CCPA compliance with AI face blurring.
  4. Premium Aesthetics: An interface designed for elite users and high-impact workflows.

docs.title: Architecture
docs.text: HUMANEXA uses a modern microservices architecture, composed of a robust backend API, a dynamic React frontend, and a specialized Python AI worker for advanced verification tasks.

docs.title: High-Level System Architecture
docs.text:
graph TD
    Client[Web/Mobile Client] --> API_Gateway[Nginx/API Gateway]
    API_Gateway --> Frontend[React SPA]
    API_Gateway --> Backend[Node.js Express API]
    Backend --> MongoDB[(MongoDB Core Data)]
    Backend --> Postgres[(PostgreSQL Audit Logs)]
    Backend --> Redis[(Redis Cache/Queues)]
    Backend -- AI Tasks --> AIService[Python FastAPI]
    AIService --> Models[TensorFlow/PyTorch/OpenCV]
    Backend -- Assets --> S3[AWS S3]

docs.title: AI Service API Reference
docs.text: The AI Service is a high-performance Python FastAPI application responsible for image analysis and verification.

docs.title: Endpoints
docs.text: Base Path: /ai (Internal network only)

docs.title: 1. Face Blurring
docs.text:
• URL: /process/blur
  • Method: POST
  • Payload: multipart/form-data (Image file)
  • Response: Returns the processed image with all detected human faces obfuscated.

docs.title: 2. Deepfake Detection
docs.text:
• URL: /verify/deepfake
  • Method: POST
  • Payload: multipart/form-data (Image file)
  • Response: 
    {
  "is_authentic": true,
  "confidence_score": 0.98,
  "artifacts_detected": []
}

docs.title: 3. Image Similarity (Duplicate Check)
docs.text:
• URL: /verify/uniqueness
  • Method: POST
  • Payload: multipart/form-data (Image file)
  • Response: 
    {
  "is_unique": true,
  "similarity_score": 0.05,
  "matched_with": null
}

docs.title: Backend API Reference
docs.text: The Node.js Express backend exposes several RESTful endpoints for the frontend application.

docs.title: Authentication
docs.text:
Base Path: /api/auth

  • POST /register - Register a new user (Donor, Helper, Admin).
  • POST /login - Authenticate and receive JWT.
  • POST /refresh - Refresh access token.

docs.title: Escrow & Donations
docs.text:
Base Path: /api/escrow

  • POST /initiate - Lock funds in escrow for a specific need.
  • POST /release - Release funds from escrow to the helper upon AI verification.
  • GET /logs/:userId - Retrieve immutable Sincerity Logs for a user.

docs.title: Certificates
docs.text:
Base Path: /api/certificates

  • GET /:userId - Retrieve the current Sincerity Tier and Impact Points for a user.
  • GET /verify/:hash - Verify the authenticity of a generated certificate via its blockchain hash.

docs.title: AI Verification Pipeline
docs.text: HUMANEXA leverages state-of-the-art artificial intelligence to maintain platform integrity, protect recipient privacy, and prevent charity fraud.

docs.title: 1. Automated Privacy (Face Blurring)
docs.text: All images uploaded to HUMANEXA as Proof-of-Delivery (PoD) are automatically processed by our Python AI worker (using OpenCV) to detect and blur faces. * Why: To ensure GDPR/CCPA compliance and protect the dignity of individuals receiving aid. * How: Haar cascades and deep learning-based face detection pipelines run before the image is ever saved to standard storage.

docs.title: 2. Fraud Detection
docs.text: To prevent the reuse of old or generic "proof" images: * Similarity Checks: We use CLIP and image embedding comparisons to ensure the uploaded image has not been used in previous campaigns. * Deepfake Detection: Analysis of image noise profiles and artifacts to detect synthesized images. * Metadata Verification: EXIF data extraction confirms the time and location the photo was taken.

docs.title: 3. Geolocation Matching
docs.text: Real-time GPS mapping ensures that the "Need" location and the "Delivery" location match within an acceptable radius, proving physical proximity and delivery.

docs.title: Sincerity Certificates (6-Tier Premium System)
docs.text: HUMANEXA rewards consistent and verified impact with the Sincerity Certificate System. Our certificates are designed with ultra-premium gradients, glassmorphism, and metallic textures.

docs.title: The 6 Tiers of Impact
docs.text:
1. Welcome (Default)
  2. Awarded upon initial verification.

  3. Aesthetic: Clean glassmorphism with subtle cyan accents.

  4. Bronze (10+ Impact Points)

  5. Aesthetic: Matte bronze finish, warm undertones.

  6. Silver (50+ Impact Points)

  7. Aesthetic: Brushed steel, sleek and professional.

  8. Gold (250+ Impact Points)

  9. Aesthetic: High-shine gold foil, glowing micro-animations.

  10. Platinum (1000+ Impact Points)

  11. Aesthetic: Premium dark metallic finish with iridescent highlights.

  12. Diamond (Elite / Special Recognition)

  13. Aesthetic: Refracting ice/diamond gradients, particle effects, and extreme rarity.

docs.title: Technical Implementation
docs.text: Certificates are generated dynamically in the React frontend using the PremiumCertificate.tsx wrapper. Features include: * HTML-to-PDF Export: Using jsPDF and html2canvas. * Blockchain Hash: Each certificate embeds a unique verification hash. * Dynamic QR Codes: Allowing anyone to verify the certificate's authenticity online.

docs.title: The Sincerity Protocol
docs.text: The Sincerity Protocol is the fundamental trust layer of HUMANEXA. It ensures that every transaction is transparent, every helper is verified, and every donation reaches its intended destination.

docs.title: 1. The Escrow Protocol
docs.text: High-value donations are not sent directly to recipients. Instead, they are held in a secure Escrow until Proof-of-Delivery (PoD) is verified. * Stage 1: Donor initiates a transaction. Funds enter the Escrow vault. * Stage 2: Helper fulfills the need and submits photo/video evidence. * Stage 3: AI verifies the evidence (deepfake check, geolocation match, face-blurring for privacy). * Stage 4: Funds are released to the helper/vendor, and an immutable log is generated.

docs.title: 2. Sincerity Logs
docs.text: Inspired by blockchain technology, Sincerity Logs provide an immutable, SHA-256 hashed record of every significant action (donation, verification, delivery) on the platform. These logs are accessible to the donor, ensuring 100% transparency.

docs.title: 3. Trust Nodes
docs.text: The Donor Discovery Map visualizes verified helpers and active needs as "Trust Nodes." Each node is scored based on past successful deliveries and peer ratings.

docs.title: Quickstart
docs.text: Get HUMANEXA running locally for development and testing.

docs.title: Prerequisites
docs.text:
• Node.js 20+
  • Python 3.10+
  • MongoDB (Running locally on port 27017)
  • Redis (Running locally on port 6379)

docs.title: 1. Clone the Repository
docs.text:
git clone https://github.com/gokulm-dev-official/HUMANEXA---AI-Powered-Social-Impact-Platform-Application.git
cd HUMANEXA---AI-Powered-Social-Impact-Platform-Application

docs.title: 2. Start the Backend API
docs.text:
The backend is a Node.js Express application. 

cd backend
npm install
npm run dev

docs.title: 3. Start the AI Service
docs.text:
The AI service is a Python FastAPI application. 

cd ai_service
# Create and activate virtual environment
python -m venv venv

# Windows:
.\venv\Scripts\activate
# Linux/Mac:
source venv/bin/activate

# Install requirements
pip install -r requirements.txt

# Start the service
python -m app.main

docs.title: 4. Start the Frontend
docs.text:
The frontend is a React Single Page Application (SPA). 

cd frontend
npm install
npm run dev

You can now access the frontend at http://localhost:5173.

docs.title: Donor Guide
docs.text: As a Donor on HUMANEXA, you are part of the elite "Trust Economy." You have the power to make an immediate impact with absolute transparency.

docs.title: Donor Discovery Map
docs.text: The primary interface for donors is the Donor Discovery Map. 1. Navigate to the Map: Log in and select "Discovery Map" from the dashboard. 2. Explore Nodes: You will see geographic "Trust Nodes" representing either active needs (red) or verified helpers (blue). 3. Analyze Sincerity Scores: Click on a helper node to view their Sincerity Score and historical delivery success rate.

docs.title: Using the Escrow Protocol
docs.text: For high-value donations, we recommend using the Escrow Protocol. 1. Select an active need and click Fund via Escrow. 2. Your funds are placed into a secure holding state. 3. Once the helper delivers the goods and uploads AI-verified proof, the funds are automatically released. 4. You will receive a Sincerity Log detailing the exact hash and verification metadata of your impact.

docs.title: Sincerity Certificates
docs.text: Donors are also eligible for Sincerity Certificates based on their total volume of verified impact. These certificates can be exported as PDFs or shared on social media.

docs.title: Helper Guide
docs.text: Helpers are the backbone of HUMANEXA. Whether you are an institutional social worker or a grassroots volunteer, the platform provides tools to verify your impact and build your Sincerity Score.

docs.title: Fulfilling a Need
docs.text:
1. Accept a Request: Browse the map or dashboard for active needs in your area.
  2. Execute: Purchase or deliver the required goods/services to the recipient.
  3. Upload Proof: Take clear photos or videos of the delivery.

    [!NOTE] Do not worry about privacy; our AI service will automatically blur the faces of recipients before the images are stored.

  4. Verification: Wait for the AI and admin systems to verify your proof (checking geolocation, deepfake status, and image uniqueness).
  5. Reward: Once verified, you will receive your funds (if via Escrow) and your Sincerity Score will increase.

docs.title: Climbing the Certificate Tiers
docs.text: As you successfully complete verified deliveries, you will earn Impact Points. Accumulate points to upgrade your Sincerity Certificate from Welcome tier all the way to Diamond.
